beats.lead: Excel believes in a day that never happened
beats.text: It treats 1900 as a leap year. It was not one.
beats.note: Microsoft documents this as a known behaviour.

beats.text: Lotus 1-2-3 made the error first. Multiplan and Excel matched it.
beats.note: That let users move worksheets between the programs.

beats.text: Excel handles 2100 correctly, along with every other century year.
Fixing it would move almost every date in current worksheets back by one day.
beats.note: Microsoft says the disadvantages of correcting it outweigh the advantages.

beats.text: The mistake is now written into an international standard.
